verdict.rationale: Sentry's Dashboards docs confirm broad, multi-project overviews built from widgets that visualize different datasets (rich visualization types), and dashboards are a core product feature (sentry-docs-4, sentry-docs-22, sentry-docs-35). However, there is no evidence of template variables (parameterized dashboards) or explicit dashboard-sharing/permalink functionality in the pack. missing for 10: template variables support, explicit shareable/permalink dashboard functionality, independent SRE hands-on corroboration.
